comments.body:
This seems to be a new problem with Jax 0.4.33. Workaround for me:
`pip3 install jax==0.4.31`

@matthewlai what jax-metal version are you using? I tried jax 0.4.31 but then got
`RuntimeError: Unable to initialize backend 'METAL': INVALID_ARGUMENT: Mismatched PJRT plugin PJRT API version (0.47) and framework PJRT API version 0.54).`

Have you set ENABLE_PJRT_COMPATIBILITY=1?

See https://developer.apple.com/metal/jax/

I'm on the latest (0.1.0).
@shuhand0 is looking at this. The workaround is to downgrade to jax 0.4.31 for now.
@matthewlai the link says that jax-metal 0.1.0 is compatible with jaxlib 0.4.31, but setting the env variable worked, thanks!
It seems the issue is resolved by downgrade jaxlib version. JAX-metal compatibility issue beyond JAX 0.5.0 is tracked by #27062. Can we close this one?

The last release of jax-metal was over a year ago now, and so it seems pretty clear that the team behind it is no longer working on it. We've removed mentions of jax-metal from JAX's installation docs: at this point I think it's probably best for users to consider the jax-metal project dead, and to focus on using supported backends.
